note: Germany follows the usual build-up, taking Anschluss in 1937 and then subjugating Czechoslovakia.
World War II begins on 1 January 1939 and Europe capitulates to the Axis within a month.

The Axis drives through Egypt and down toward South Africa, but is eventually pushed back across Africa to roughly the Ethiopia line. West Africa holds until late 1939 before being pushed by the Axis.
The Winter War starts. Finland holds for a few weeks, then loses and falls back to the normal border rather than being annexed.
Japan enters the war in early 1941, immediately invades the Dutch East Indies and the Philippines, and pushes up to the river line in India.
Barbarossa begins on 28 March 1941. By June, the Axis takes the key Soviet cities via the main front, Finland, and an Iran front.
